definition.cancelled: Setup check cancelled. Review current setup information before continuing.
definition.description: Check the official catalog for setup options. Checking does not install or replace game files.
definition.ineligible: The offered setup could not be selected. Review the current setup options and requirements.
definition.revoked: The publisher withdrew this setup. Review the current options before continuing.
definition.selected: Setup information checked. Review the current setup options before continuing.
definition.unsupported: The setup check returned an unsupported result. Review current setup information.
